description: Defines data structures and type aliases for configuring UE (User Equipment) resources and BWP (Bandwidth Part) configurations in a scheduler component, including classes for BWP configuration, UE cell resources, and parameters for UE creation and reconfiguration.

classes.name: bwp_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for a Bandwidth Part (BWP), including identifiers, common and dedicated configurations for downlink and uplink, associated core sets and search spaces, and UE BWP configuration.

classes.name: ue_cell_res_config
classes.description: Structure representing UE-dedicated resources for a specific cell, including cell index, core sets, search spaces, BWP list, and optional serving cell configurations.

classes.name: ue_creation_params
classes.description: Parameters used to generate a UE configuration object, including configuration request, logical channel list, and cell configurations.

classes.name: ue_reconfig_params
classes.description: Parameters used to reconfigure a UE configuration object, including configuration request, optional logical channel list, and cell configurations.
